integrity: The arbitrary-size claim has a self-contained mathematical proof. A standard-library finite exact checker directly compares exposed vertices and graph distances and is included. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact reciprocal-distance formula concerns the label-refined survival of braid walls for trees with strictly positive connected-tube simplex weights, not graphs with cycles or distinct edges of the quotient polytope. It requires the fixed coordinate labels. Unidentified equivalent prior work and independent mathematical validation are outstanding.
title: Inverse-distance braid-wall law for tree associahedra
